DatabaseHealth.description: The database component: the one authoritative SQLite file.

journal_mode.description: The connection's journal mode; the product requires `wal`.

last_change_at.description: When the newest timeline row was recorded; absent when nothing is recorded yet.

schema_version.description: The applied schema version after migration.

HerdrConnectionDiagnostics.description: Connection diagnostics for one Project's Herdr session.

connected.description: Whether the per-session socket is connected.

herdr_workspace.description: The required target Herdr workspace, resolved inside the effective session.

last_error.description: The last connection or mapping error, if any.

last_snapshot_at.description: When the last full snapshot was captured.

product_workspace.description: The product Seed Workspace this session maps to.

session_name.description: The named Herdr session, if the Project selected one; absence selects Herdr's default session.

HerdrHealth.description: The Herdr component: every session the core is observing.

sessions.description: One entry per observed Project, in Project identity order.

HerdrSessionHealth.description: One observed Herdr session, named by the Project it serves.

diagnostics.description: The binding's live connection diagnostics, the same shape `herdr.settings.get` serves.

project_id.description: The Project whose Herdr binding this session is.

McpHealth.description: The MCP component: the tool surface the core exposes to adapters.

exposed_tools.description: How many MCP tool definitions the catalogue exposes.

SchedulerHealth.description: The scheduler component: the daily backup loop the core owns.

last_backup_success_at.description: When the daily backup last succeeded, from the scheduler's persisted state; absent until one has.

ServiceHealth.description: The service component: the core process answering the query.

started_at.description: When this core process started serving; its state last changed by coming into being.

WorkspaceHealthCounts.description: The Workspace census across every Project, one count per health state in the closed vocabulary.

dirty.description: Present with an unclean working tree.

missing.description: The path is absent or not a worktree of the repository.

retired.description: Retired by the operator; the record is preserved.

unobserved.description: Present, but the last git status read could not complete.

WorkspacesHealth.description: The Workspace component: the registered working copies.

by_health.description: The health census across every Project.

last_change_at.description: When a Workspace last changed on the timeline; absent until one has.
